text:
maria: Hey folks — PR #4823 (migration guide for retries/backoff) is blocked. Reviewer asked for a crisp statement about default retry/backoff behavior for Hosted API vs SDKs. I couldn’t find a single line in the reference. Can someone confirm server-side behavior and SDK defaults? @kevin @tom

kevin: Quick summary — Redwood hosted endpoints do NOT perform automatic application-level retries for normal request/response calls. Retries are implemented in the client SDKs. Current defaults (as of runtime v2.3): JS SDK: 3 attempts, exponential backoff starting at 200ms, max backoff 2000ms. Python SDK: 4 attempts, exponential backoff starting at 150ms, max 2500ms. Also: use an Idempotency-Key header for safe retries on non-streaming generation endpoints.

maria: awesome — can you drop a small code snippet I can paste into the docs?

kevin: sure — paste below (JS example):

```js
// JS SDK client config snippet to show defaults
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  retries: 3,
  backoffMs: 200,
  maxBackoffMs: 2000,
});

// Example with Idempotency-Key for safe retry
await client.generate({ prompt: '...', headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': 'abc-123' } });
```

maria: perfect. Also need to be explicit in the migration guide about streaming vs non-streaming — do streaming endpoints support Idempotency-Key?

kevin: streaming endpoints do NOT use Idempotency-Key — they’re not retry-safe at the protocol-level. Add a note: "Idempotency-Key is only honored for non-streaming synchronous generation endpoints."

tom: CI heads up — docs preview failing linkcheck. The cross-link to /runtime-internals is flagged because that doc is in the private repo. We need to either swap to the public 'serving-behavior' page or put a short inline explainer here. @sasha any preference?

sasha: prefer swapping to public 'serving-behavior' if it covers retries/backoff. If not, put a 2-3 line inline explanation and reference internal doc in the dev-only section. We shouldn't keep a public link to private content.

maria: I'll replace the link with a short inline paragraph and call out "internal: runtime details" under a dev-only note. Pushed the change.

doc-preview-bot: Preview ready — https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/pr-4823 — checks: build OK, accessibility OK, linkcheck: 1 warning (private link removed).

maria: Proposed wording for the docs (Behavior section):
"Redwood hosted API does not automatically retry application requests on 5xx or network failures. SDKs provide client-side retry logic with exponential backoff (JS default: 3 attempts, Python default: 4). To safely retry requests, include an Idempotency-Key header for non-streaming generation endpoints. Streaming endpoints are not retry-safe and do not honor Idempotency-Key."

kevin: tiny edit suggestion — add parenthetical with backoff starting values for clarity. Otherwise +1.

maria: updated the PR text with that edit.

ci-bot: docs preview succeeded. Linkcheck cleared. No blocking CI failures.

tom: I'll do the review and approve once you swap that one remaining internal link (looks like you already did). ETA ~25-30m. :thumbsup:

maria: thank you — pinging reviewers. If anyone else sees an edge-case we missed (batching/proxy timeouts), call it out here.

kevin: one more edge-case to note in a footnote: long-polling proxies may close connections earlier than SDK backoff windows; recommend lowering max backoff if behind aggressive proxies. I'll add a short note in the PR.

maria: added the footnote. marking this thread resolved for docs blockers, leaving for reviewers to approve and merge. :white_check_mark:
